findings.title: Reflected XSS via iframe src injection — CTF flag extracted
findings.description: The /page endpoint reflects the `url` GET parameter directly into an iframe `src` attribute without sanitization. Supplying `javascript:alert('XSS')` as the URL value executes arbitrary JavaScript in the iframe context, bypassing any content restrictions. The server validates the XSS payload server-side and returns the CTF flag upon success.
